verdict.rationale: CRM sync is a fair question for an AI meeting-notes product, but the evidence pack never mentions a native HubSpot, Salesforce, or Attio integration, or any matching of notes to contact or deal records. The Developer API, webhooks and MCP server are developer building blocks a team could use to build such a sync, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, meeting notes and summaries sync automatically onto the right contact and deal records in my CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio)
